transitions.event: TCP connection established and greeting sent

transitions.action: server acquires resources associated with the client's maildrop
POP3 server releases any resources acquired during the TRANSACTION state and says goodbye; TCP connection is closed
acquires an exclusive-access lock on the maildrop; responds with a positive status indicator
responds with a negative status indicator
server issues a positive response with a line containing information for the maildrop (drop listing)
server issues a positive response with scan listing(s) or an error if no such message
server sends the message corresponding to the given message-number or issues an error
server marks the message as deleted or issues an error
server replies with a positive response
server unmarks any messages marked as deleted and replies with a positive response

The POP3 server removes all messages marked as deleted from the maildrop and replies as to the status of this operation. Whether the removal was successful or not, the server then releases any exclusive-access lock on the maildrop and closes the TCP connection.
